findings.trigger: A tenant (e.g., bank_beta) invokes status update, escalation, dual-control sign, resolve, note addition, or SAR generation for another tenant's case (e.g., bank_alpha) by case_id.
findings.expected_business_semantics: Authoritative backend boundary must reject cross-tenant case operations with HTTP 403 Forbidden.
findings.actual_behavior: Only GET /{case_id} verified tenant isolation. Mutation endpoints lacked caller_tenant enforcement, permitting cross-tenant object manipulation (BOLA).
findings.first_divergence: Missing _enforce_case_tenant checks in mutation endpoint function signatures.
findings.downstream_impact: Multi-tenant data breach and unauthorized case tampering across consortium banks.
findings.regulatory_reporting_impact: A foreign bank could generate regulatory SAR filings for another bank's case.
findings.root_cause: Omission of TenantDep dependency and tenant boundary verification on mutation routes in cases.py.
findings.repair: Introduced _enforce_case_tenant(case, caller_tenant) helper and wired caller_tenant: TenantDep across all case routes.

findings.trigger: Client requests case details for an arbitrary non-existent RFC-4122 UUID.
findings.expected_business_semantics: Non-existent case IDs must truthfully return None / HTTP 404 Not Found.
findings.actual_behavior: get_case checked is_uuid regex and synthesized a fake mock case with random risk scores and fake titles for any valid UUID, violating Zero Dummy Mock invariant.
findings.first_divergence: case_service.py line 253 regex branch synthesising fake case data.
findings.downstream_impact: API reported phantom cases and synthetic investigation records for non-existent entities.
findings.tenant_impact: Phantom data presented without tenant provenance.
findings.retry_concurrency_impact: Allowed state mutations on ephemeral mock objects.
findings.regulatory_reporting_impact: Permitted generating SAR packages for non-existent cases.
findings.root_cause: Legacy demo fallback intended only for static demo IDs was improperly applied to all UUIDs.
findings.repair: Removed general is_uuid synthesis branch. Preserved explicit canonical demo IDs (CASE-98492, CASE-2026-001, CASE-2026-004) only.

findings.trigger: Calling assign_case or link_alert on an already finalized case in CLOSED_CONFIRMED or CLOSED_FALSE_POSITIVE status.
findings.expected_business_semantics: Terminal case states are strictly immutable (Replay Resistance Invariant). Attempted mutations must raise TerminalCaseImmutableError.
findings.actual_behavior: assign_case reset status to ASSIGNED, resurrecting closed cases; link_alert appended alerts to closed cases without restriction.
findings.first_divergence: Missing terminal immutability guard in assign_case and link_alert.
findings.downstream_impact: Finalized regulatory dispositions could be reopened or altered post-filing.
findings.retry_concurrency_impact: Allowed post-terminal state mutation and replay desynchronization.
findings.regulatory_reporting_impact: Violated audit hash-chain integrity of closed investigation files.
findings.root_cause: Terminal immutability was only checked in change_status, not in assign_case or link_alert.
findings.repair: Added if not case.is_open: raise TerminalCaseImmutableError(...) in both assign_case and link_alert.

findings.trigger: Concurrent analysts submit conflicting status transitions based on stale case state snapshots.
findings.expected_business_semantics: System must support optimistic concurrency control, rejecting stale transitions with HTTP 409 Conflict.
findings.actual_behavior: Status update unconditionally applied the last submitted transition, silently overwriting concurrent analyst actions (lost updates).
findings.first_divergence: Absence of expected_status precondition parameter in CaseStatusRequest and change_status.
findings.downstream_impact: Stale requests could overwrite newer supervisor approvals or rejections.
findings.regulatory_reporting_impact: Could silently overwrite an escalated case with an unreviewed state.
findings.root_cause: Lack of optimistic locking precondition in case status mutation workflow.
findings.repair: Added expected_status: str | None to CaseStatusRequest and enforced precondition in change_status, returning HTTP 409 on mismatch.

findings.trigger: Client invokes POST /api/v1/cases/{case_id}/file-sar on a case resolved as CLOSED_FALSE_POSITIVE or unreviewed OPEN.
findings.expected_business_semantics: SAR regulatory packages must fail closed upfront with HTTP 400 if the case is a false positive or has not completed investigation.
findings.actual_behavior: file_sar_report router endpoint did not validate case status before invoking generator.
findings.first_divergence: Missing status precondition guard in file_sar_report route handler.
findings.downstream_impact: Could generate and seal false regulatory filings for non-fraudulent activity.
findings.regulatory_reporting_impact: False positive activity improperly prepared as FinCEN suspicious activity report.
findings.root_cause: Lack of status gating in presentation route handler.
findings.repair: Added status checks in file_sar_report rejecting CLOSED_FALSE_POSITIVE, OPEN, and ASSIGNED cases with HTTP 400.

findings.trigger: Kafka consumer redelivers an alert or network transport retries webhook dispatch.
findings.expected_business_semantics: Downstream external receivers must receive a stable, deterministic event ID enabling idempotent deduplication across retries.
findings.actual_behavior: dispatch_event generated a new random uuid4 on each delivery attempt, breaking receiver deduplication.
findings.first_divergence: webhook_service.py line 154 using random uuid4 for event_id.
findings.downstream_impact: External SIEM and partner bank systems processed the same logical alert as multiple independent fraud incidents.
findings.retry_concurrency_impact: At-least-once transport retries created duplicate external side effects.
findings.root_cause: Omission of deterministic event identity derivation from payload object attributes.
findings.repair: Updated dispatch_event to accept optional event_id or derive stable hash: evt_<sha256(tenant:type:id)[:12]>.
